Name: No more Stumps in Town
Author: SnoringSnorr
Description:
Are you also bothered by all the tree stumps in the town that make the area look really barren?

I was, so I quickly threw a mod together that replaces all the tree stumps leading up to the mountain and the ones in front of the museum with actual full trees!

[b]Keep in mind that you are not able to cut these down, like all other trees in the town map, these are purely visual.[/b]

This mod simply requires content patcher and SMAPI and should be compatible with basically anything that doesnt change the location of where the stumps on the original map were.

Also check out my other mods or follow me on twitter! [url=https://twitter.com/SnoringSnorr]@SnoringSnorr[/url]
